text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Contacts with the Greeks more frequent one year after normalisation of Greek-Macedonian relations. European Union representatives and Macedonian and Greek experts to draft feasibility study on protection of Dojran lake.
- Protocol of Macedonian-Chinese economic cooperation signed in Peking.
- The World Bank will support foreign investments in Macedonia. The bank to promote change of business conditions in the country.
